_comment: Laravel at the repo root, runs in Sail (service laravel.test). Branch names come from git, not from this file.

commands.phpstan: docker compose -f "./docker-compose.yml" exec -u sail laravel.test ./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=512M 2>&1
commands.test: docker compose -f "./docker-compose.yml" exec -u sail laravel.test php artisan test --compact 2>&1
commands.test:filter: docker compose -f "./docker-compose.yml" exec -u sail laravel.test php artisan test --compact --filter={FILTER} 2>&1
commands.test:bg: docker compose -f "./docker-compose.yml" exec -d -u sail laravel.test sh -c 'rm -f storage/logs/test-run.log; php artisan test --compact --colors=never > storage/logs/test-run.log 2>&1; echo EXIT=$? >> storage/logs/test-run.log'
commands.test:bg:wait: until grep -q '^EXIT=' storage/logs/test-run.log 2>/dev/null; do sleep 15; done; grep -E 'Tests:|Duration|FAILED|EXIT=' storage/logs/test-run.log
commands.migrate: docker compose -f "./docker-compose.yml" exec -u sail laravel.test php artisan migrate --force 2>&1
commands.make:model: docker compose -f "./docker-compose.yml" exec -u sail laravel.test php artisan make:model {PATH} 2>&1
commands.make:test: docker compose -f "./docker-compose.yml" exec -u sail laravel.test php artisan make:test {PATH} --pest 2>&1
